lines.text: Recruit, Dr. Hale here. Welcome to the DeusEdix training wing.
lines.name: V1479691

lines.text: I'm in the booth behind the glass, up on your left. Yes, I can see you. That's rather the point.
lines.name: V13054006

lines.text: Everything here was built in the editor a few minutes ago, on your own machine. Walk the rooms and inspect your work.
lines.name: V1143189

lines.text: Room one, the stores. The crate you moved, and the one you placed on top of the crate stockpile platform.
lines.name: V9632280

lines.text: Every object of the game is one click away in the palette. The quartermaster would weep with joy.
lines.name: V12169210

lines.text: Room two. Use the button.
lines.name: V10041377

lines.text: The door opens because you told it to: when JC uses the button, open the door. No tags, no events, no code.
lines.name: V3423366

lines.text: My colleagues behind the glass built doors for twenty years. They are pretending not to be impressed.
lines.name: V2718331

lines.text: Room three. The trooper greets you with the gesture you picked in his properties.
lines.name: V7493485

lines.text: My colleague on the sideline has her own gesture. She calls it supervising. We call it stretching.
lines.name: V5061307

lines.text: Room four. Talk to my colleague: she says what you wrote for her in the Story panel.
lines.name: V8933380

lines.text: If she says anything you didn't write, report it to me at once. Then walk calmly to the exit.
lines.name: V1144708

lines.text: Last room, the library. The books hold the tips that did not fit in a lesson.
lines.name: V13039965

lines.text: That concludes the training, agent. Good work.
lines.name: V13685381

lines.text: I'll file the report now, before anyone asks what we spent on coffee this quarter.
lines.name: V3272016

lines.text: Room five. My smiling crate and your response.
lines.name: V10166658

lines.text: Change the plain crate's skin in the Texture Editor. I expect restraint, legibility, and very little competition.
lines.name: V4135268

lines.text: The committee called mine approachable. They were referring to the crate.
lines.name: V9038766

lines.text: The film stage. Use the screening button to play the shot you made.
lines.name: V13763941

lines.text: The last cup of coffee in this facility, under armed protection. This is a training scenario. Mostly.
lines.name: V5781149

lines.text: When the film ends, carry on to the library. Please leave the principal actor on its pedestal.
lines.name: V10546225

lines.text: Welcome to the DeusEdix training. I am Dr. Elias Hale; I watch the rooms from behind the glass, up on your left.
lines.name: V10357385

lines.text: Everything here was built in the editor a few minutes ago, on your own machine. Walk through the rooms and see what you made.
lines.name: V6702622

lines.text: Room one. The crate you moved, and the one you placed on the green plate. Every object of the game is one click away in the palette.
lines.name: V15297897

lines.text: Room two. Use the button. The door opens because you told it to: when JC uses the button, open the door. No tags, no events, no code.
lines.name: V7081724

lines.text: Room three. The trooper greets you with the gesture you picked in his properties. My colleagues behind the glass have theirs too.
lines.name: V5132388

lines.text: Last room, the library. The books hold the tips that did not fit in a lesson. That is the training. Good work.
